title: Founder Trustees - KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur
text:
FOUNDER TRUSTEES OF KITCOEK

KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur (KITCOEK) was founded in May 1983 by a group of visionary industrialists, seasoned professionals, and esteemed educationalists from the Kolhapur region. It was the first self-financed engineering college established in Maharashtra.

FOUNDER TRUSTEES
- Late Shri. Shivajirao D. Desai — Founder Chairman
- Late Shri. Mohammedhussein M. Hudli — Founder Vice Chairman
- Late Shri. Sudhakar (Bhausaheb) S. Kulkarni — Founder Secretary
- Late Shri. Ram Menon — Trustee
- Late Shri. Laxman Bhausaheb Chougule — Trustee
- Late Shri. Devgouda Sidgouda Patil — Trustee
- Late Shri. M.R. Pungavkar — Trustee
- Late Shri. C.D. Joshi — Trustee
- Late Shri. A.P. Rane — Trustee
- Late Shri. Rajaram S. Beri — Trustee

VISION OF THE FOUNDERS
The founders had a vision to bridge the gap between industry and academia, ensuring students receive practical, industry-relevant engineering education. Their combined experience in industry, academia, and public service helped shape KITCOEK into a premier institution.

The institute has grown under this foundational vision from a single engineering college into a multi-disciplinary institution offering 10 undergraduate, 6 postgraduate programs, and 4 PhD research centres, with over 19,000 engineers graduated.
